manifest.exclusion_rule: Token excluded from active-concept ranking if: (1) decoded string, stripped+lowercased, is empty or has no alphabetic character (punctuation/digits/whitespace); (2) single ASCII letter; (3) in fixed English function-word list (~110 words, see STOP in run.py); (4) token id occurs in prompt token ids; (5) normalized string matches lowercased prompt at word boundaries; (6) tokenizer special token (chat markup). Candidates deduplicated by normalized string, highest score kept. Score = max over mid-band layers x all positions of J-lens softmax probability.
manifest.bottomk_rule: ranks 500-k+1..500 of the filtered active pool
manifest.random_control: k iid gaussian directions per layer, QR-orthonormalized by the ablate op; subspace dimension exactly matches real
